identificationModule.briefTitle: Study Comparing ZG006 With Investigator-Selected Chemotherapy in Participants With Relapsed Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled, Open-Label Phase III Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of ZG006 for Injection Compared With Investigator-Selected Chemotherapy in Participants With Relapsed Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The main objective is to compare ZG006 with Investigator-Selected Chemotherapy on prolonging overall survival (OS).

interventions.name: ZG006
interventions.description: ZG006 will be administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion.

interventions.name: Topotecan
interventions.description: Topotecan will be administered per local standard of care

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with adverse events (AEs)
